excerpt: The predicted, patch and elided fidelities all show good agreement with the fidelities of the corresponding full circuits, despite vast differences in computational complexity and entanglement.
overview: This formal comparison matters because direct XEB verification is unavailable for the final hardest circuits. Agreement in tractable regimes justifies using lower-complexity circuit variants as fidelity estimators, while leaving open future improvements in classical simulation methods.
title: Verification Circuit Agreement
